title: Hasina Supporters Vandalise BNP Office In Bangladesh's Gopalganj Amid Fresh Violence
text:
Fresh political violence has erupted in Bangladesh as supporters of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina intensify protests against the government. A Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) office was vandalised in Gopalganj, while the ancestral home of former interim leader Muhammad Yunus was set on fire in Chattogram.

The unrest comes amid an Awami League campaign demanding Hasina's return from exile in India. The violence has also prompted heightened security deployments across several districts.

title: Meta says 'reevaluating' 2030 net zero target amid AI buildout
text: Meta said Thursday it was reconsidering its 2030 deadline for net zero emissions because of the artificial intelligence boom, the latest in a broad retreat by corporations on global warming targets. The reality has been far more complex," the executives wrote, adding that delivering on Meta's vision "requires building the infrastructure that powers AI." title: India's wheat area set for steepest decline in 26 years as farmers switch crops
text: India is experiencing its most severe decline in wheat acreage in 26 years due to insufficient monsoon rains. The government's minimal increase in wheat procurement prices has also discouraged wheat planting among farmers. As a result, wheat acreage is expected to drop to its lowest level in four years.

According to the official data released by the Commerce and Industry Ministry on Friday, the core sector expanded by 8.2 per cent in September 2026.
Among segments, iron ore output rose by 26.4 per cent, electricity by 21.6 per cent, coal by 23.1 per cent, and cement by 15.4 per cent.

text: A seven-week-old Asian elephant calf named Raja is being urgently airlifted from Assam to Gujarat for specialized medical attention. Despite the dedicated care from the Vantara team, hospitalization has become essential for Raja to undergo a thorough veterinary evaluation and receive necessary treatments upon arrival.
